reference_description: User-provided Frostlace tile asset sheet showing frosted_stone, archive_stone and crystal_stone across floor, wall, edge, prop and variation examples.
strategy: derive continuous material language from quiet reference areas; remove decorative/object-scale semantics; synthesize deterministic multiscale microtexture; quantize source master to 64-color PNG; validate with the exact V2 normalizer and manual semantic QA

masters.reference_sampling: quiet frosted floor-stone material area; decorative snowflake/sigil variants excluded
masters.semantic_notes: Continuous blue-gray frosted stone grain; no snowflake symbols, sigils, slab seams, borders, objects, or large cracks.

masters.reference_sampling: quiet warm archive-stone floor material area; circular archive glyphs and fitted slabs excluded
masters.semantic_notes: Continuous warm pale dressed-stone grain; no sigils, circles, slab boundaries, joints, borders, objects, or masonry layout.

masters.reference_sampling: dark lavender crystal-stone background statistics sampled from floor examples; large glowing polygon/sigil geometry masked out; only micro-scale cyan/violet mineral flecks retained
masters.semantic_notes: Continuous dark lavender-blue stone with tiny cyan/violet mineral inclusions; no paving polygons, joint networks, large facets, crystal objects, borders, or sigils.

manual_qa_basis: 384x384 reference-derived masters plus exact V2-normalized 48x48 tiles and full compiled Frostlace A5 visual inspection
